cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. I'll accept your apology for missing my birthday if I get first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum already expects me Christmas Day.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Boxing Day, then. In exchange, I'll tell her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather you actually stopped being hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay through New Year and I'll mean it. I'll even stop mentioning the birthday to Mum.

mechanism: A downplays itself as family date keeper while controlling visits and announcing emotional recovery only in return for extended time with B.
confusable: Not simply lingering hurt: apology, family reassurance and actual forgiveness are explicitly exchanged for dates A allocates.
comparison: Object access and priced reassurance versus calendar access and genuine forgiveness.
